reference.limits: No developer terms or rate limits could be read: the documentation page (/api-docs) and every terms URL guess return 404; No developer terms or rate limits could be read: the documentation page (/api-docs) and every terms URL guess return 404; the API itself is open and unauthenticated. robots.txt blocks ClaudeBot, GPTBot, CCBot, Bytespider, Amazonbot, CloudflareBrowserRenderingCrawler with Disallow: / for unlisted agents — the API endpoint, not the HTML, is the sanctioned path.

search.note: Public API ('No authentication required'): GET /api/v0/search/jobs with query, remote, page ('starting at 1') and per_page (maximum 120); expand=["company"] is sent so the company name is inline. country_code takes alpha-3 codes (example 'CHL') and there is no free-text place filter, so location and country are not sent. JSON:API hits: id is the job slug, attributes.description is HTML, attributes.published_at is a Unix epoch integer (raw), min/max_salary are integers with no documented currency, meta.total_pages is the only count (no total).

not_offered.me: No account endpoint for the public API; private endpoints use a company API key ('Company authentication for private endpoints').
not_offered.get_posting: GET /api/v0/jobs/{id} is a private endpoint (security ApiKeyAuth: 'Send Authorization: Bearer <api_key>', answered 401 without one on 2026-09-24); the public search hit already carries the full description.
not_offered.apply: POST /api/v0/applications is a company (ApiKeyAuth) endpoint for recruiters; candidates apply on getonbrd.com ('profile apply').
not_offered.list_messages: No messaging API in the public API.
